question: What was FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024?
answer: FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024 is -0.8%

FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024 is -0.8%

model_answer:
Floor & Decor (FND) had no same-store sales growth in Q4 2024. Its comparable store sales fell 0.8% in the fiscal fourth quarter, which ended December 26, 2024.

Total net sales were still up. They rose 5.7% to $1,107.4 million from $1,048.1 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2023. The gain came from new stores, since the company opened 10 new warehouse stores and ended the quarter with 251 warehouse stores and five design studios.

The Q4 decline was much smaller than earlier in the year. Comparable store sales fell 11.6% in Q1 and 6.4% in Q3. For the full year they were down 7.1%.
